To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Turkey's integration into Bologna is a case of voluntary policy transfer; (2) the agents of change in this process are the Ministry of Education, the Council of Higher Education, and the Higher Education Council; (3) the agents have been successful in institutional Europeanisation, but have failed in discursive Europeanisation; and (4) the failure of discursive Europeanisation in the area of education is due to the lack of a common language, the lack of a European identity
The Bologna Process is an example of voluntary Europeanisation.
Turkey has successfully transferred the Bologna norms in the area higher education.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of why Turkey is transferring norms and what the consequences of this transfer are.
the question of why the Bologna Process has been accepted and implemented in Turkey.
the question of how the Bologna Process is being transferred in Turkey, and how this transfer is being discursively de Europeanised.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Bologna Process has been a successful policy transfer process for Turkey.
while the Bologna Process is being implemented, the Europeanisation of higher education in Turkey is not taking place.
Turkey is Europeanising itself through higher education, yet it is not de Europeanising itself in the process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
while the agents of change are successful in transmitting norms and policies, they fail to construct a narrative which would make the society at large identify with these norms and policies.
while Turkey has adopted the norms of the Bologna Process and the European Higher Education Area (EHEA), it has not yet internalized them.
the Bologna Process is being transferred in Turkey in a way that is not in accordance with its initial aims.
The main takeaway from our work is that
while institutional Europeanization may be taking place in the higher education area in Turkey, discursive Europeanization is not.
the Bologna Process has not been successful in changing the Turkish higher education system in a way that would make it more European.
the Bologna Process is not just a set of reforms in higher education, it is also an opportunity for the EU to expand its influence in Turkey.
